context: Tests SwiftData ownership of coexistence work, persistent-store alignment, rename mapping, and precise Codable guidance.

checklist.name: SwiftData ownership
checklist.description: Treats Core Data and SwiftData coexistence or migration as SwiftData-owned guidance rather than expanding into a standalone Core Data tutorial.

checklist.name: Existing store URL
checklist.description: Points the SwiftData configuration at the existing persistent store URL when sharing or migrating the store.

checklist.name: Schema alignment
checklist.description: Requires entity names, property names, types, and relationships to align across the Core Data model and SwiftData @Model classes.

checklist.name: Rename mapping
checklist.description: Uses @Attribute(originalName:) or an equivalent persisted-name mapping for the renamed field.

checklist.name: Codable precision
checklist.description: Allows compatible Codable structs or enums as SwiftData properties without inventing an unsupported iOS 18-only availability threshold.

checklist.name: Single writer
checklist.description: Assigns one persistence stack as the writer for each entity during migration instead of writing the same entity from Core Data and SwiftData concurrently.
